_about: Camcorder '97 · a 4:3 home tape: soft bloomy highlights, over-sharpened edges, a little chroma fringe, a green-magenta drift, coloured noise.
_tweak: chroma.amount, sharpen.amount, letterbox.on (off = full frame), grade.tint.
_stack: grade runs before bloom on purpose: on the night build bloom otherwise smears a non-finite scene pixel into a black blob (grade's clamp scrubs it). Keep grade on and first while bloom is on.
